name: Browser Back Button
description: Block that renders a clickable Back button (runs window.history.back()).
project_description:
This module provides one custom block named as "Browser Back Button Block" available in block layout section.

 By clicking the Configure button on the block, update the settings for this block and place any where in the region.

 It also supports page reload, while clicking the back button. So that any updates on the pages are reflected immediately.

 INSTALLATION 

 * Install the Back Button module as you would normally install a

 contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 

 for further information. 

 Usage : 
 
 Go to the Block Layout and place the "Back Button Block" in any active region. 
 In the "Configure block" section, add text or image for back button.
